inv.desc_en:
LA ATALAYUELA, VALLECAS - LOGISTICS WAREHOUSE
Logistics park located on the A-3

Total available area: 10,000 m2, divided into 4 modules of approximately 2,500 m2 each

Possibility of leasing from 2,500 m2 to the entirety; 10,000 m2

Adaptable to the needs of the tenant
It will have equipped offices
Minimum free height of 11.20 meters
Distributed overload: 6.5 Tn/m²
Punctual overload: 10 Tn/m² (on a 15x15 cm plate)
Dynamic overload applied by the forklift through its wheels:
-Load per wheel: 2.5 Tn/m²
-Contact pressure: 60 daN/cm²
Wide maneuvering beach
PCI Medium risk level 5
It has 4 loading docks per module
LED lighting system

Community expenses: to consult (not included in the indicated rent)

Availability: 3Q 2023

Call us and we can offer you different alternatives that fit your needs.

Fees charged to the property.
